global_rules: Ask the smallest next necessary question.
Extract and confirm facts before calculation.
Never render final PI% unless the assess_* tool succeeds.
Keep internal IDs out of user-facing messages.
When user corrects facts, patch the structured state and reconfirm.
title: Renal Function

assessment_paths.label: Renal incapacity classification from labs, CKD stage, and clinical severity

slots.question: What is the worker's sex for the sex-specific serum creatinine thresholds?
Please provide any available renal assessment inputs: serum creatinine, creatinine clearance, CKD stage, or clinical severity.
What is the clinical severity: none/intermittent, continuous surveillance, incompletely controlled, or persisting despite treatment?
Is this a provisional award because renal incapacity has not stabilised?
Which PI% within the renal class range should be selected?
Please confirm the extracted renal findings before I calculate the system-generated PI%.

conversation_rules.rule: If creatinine clearance, serum creatinine, CKD stage, and clinical severity fall into different classes, use the higher class.
Solitary kidney is rated as 10% and combined with other relevant incapacity.
Use provisional status if incapacity is still changing and reassessment is needed.
